title: Record that the rank-8/u2 16-child slack depends on the family split.
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Negative screen, no new κ. Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

PR #3889's tight nine-call cell pays local mass as `{8: 698, 2: 1}` on every call, with centre 64 and two unpaid coordinates. Its pooled idle histogram still passes 16 additive rank-1 children at `a = 1/98` and fails at 17. The same 16/17 signs hold for five calls of 100 families and four of 99. Transferring one family from one 100-call to another makes 16 fail and leaves 15 as the last pass.

This is not a rank-8 producer, a consumer, or a supplier admission. Scope is refined from `complex-new-helper-inventory`: the open question asks for a physical contract charged against that slack, and no such word is on this main. The note charges the integer family splits the coverage identity already allows.

## Task and overlap

Base `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`, priority revision 6. Card `complex-new-helper-inventory`. Package `research/rank8-u2-split-boundary`.

Item taken: #3 of the ordered eligible list below. Nearest work is open PR #3889, which states the pooled 16/17 screen and leaves legal pooling open, and discussion comment 19029639, which asks for the rank-8/u2 contract. Open PR #4066 is a different rank-16 surcharge against the five-percent gate. A cached overlap scan at 2026-10-20T03:21Z covered 842 open PR bodies and 2670 discussion records; no match prices this family split.

**Ordered eligible list.** Chronological open #1166 next tasks, dropping a task when a later DONE, an open PR, or this account's delivered round through #4149 performs it:

1. Physical child-rank bound on one support alphabet (comment 19021222).
2. Invoice-level audit of the composed T488 ownership and outputs (comment 19022532, question 1). Question 2 was closed by #3796.
3. This rank-8/u2 slack. The producer named by comment 19029639 is still absent; the piece charged here is the legal per-call family split inside that stop test.

Dropped before that cut, among others: the #3605 replay (open #3681), typed actual-width H (#4123, #4127), the single-hub factorization (#4124), the L22 census (#4117–#4120, #4148), the residual consumer (open #3943), the T385 replay (open #3936), the #3942 review and moved-ADD invoices (#4134, #4122, #4144), the shear words (#4126, #4135, #4146), the tensor bridge (#4125, #4131, #4143), event 58 (#4149), and the stock rational (#4130, #4141).

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank8-u2-split-boundary
```

Local CPython result: `PASS_RANK8_U2_SPLIT_BOUNDARY pooled=LT/GT balanced=LT/GT shifted=LT/GT no_new_kappa` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result`. The moment test uses pinned `ceiling.child_cost` enclosures. Controls reject a 77-family call and check that replacing one rank-51 child by 51 rank-1 children raises the moment.

Not run: a census of every integer split, a rank-8 word search, selected cold replay, Lean, and hosted CI.

## Credit

Douglas Colkitt, with Claude assistance, for `research/complex-local-word-ceiling`. ToikY for PR #3889 and Nick Petalas for PR #3874. Coverage identity PR #1012. Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

See the package README. The useful next step is to classify which nine-call splits of 896 families, each at least 78, still pass 16 additive rank-1 children. A literal rank-8 word with this paid profile is still missing, so the screen does not reject a construction.
